hero_title: Plan your next trip by chatting
hero_subtitle: Tell us where you want to go. Get recommendations grounded in real travel knowledge — not guesswork.
steps_subtitle: Three steps from idea to itinerary
step_describe_body: Share your destination, dates, budget, and interests in a natural conversation.
step_discover_body: We research seasonal prices, local tips, and options — every claim linked to a source.
step_go_body: Review your itinerary, adjust by chat, and book only when you explicitly confirm.
trust_sources_body: Every recommendation shows its rationale, cost context, and where the information came from.
trust_booking_body: Nothing is booked automatically. You review quotes and confirm every reservation yourself.
trust_account_body: Sign in with email, Google, or GitHub. Your trips stay private to your account.
preview_user_message: I want a week in Kyoto in November — temples, food markets, and a day trip to Nara.
preview_assistant_message: November is shoulder season — fewer crowds and mild weather. Based on local transit guides, I suggest splitting your week between central Kyoto and a Nara day trip.
